what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Uganda in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1630 Ugandan asylum seekers in South Africa, 14.3% of all asylum seekers from Uganda.
Refugees from Uganda, a separate group, live mostly in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda in periods from 1995 to 2017, with the LRA and ADF among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Uganda in 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 471 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 4586, at the end of 2017; the main years of displacement in the data include 2017 to 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
